logarithm.def: The exponent that 10 must be raised to in order to give a number: log 1000 = 3 because 10³ = 1000. Also called the base-10 or common logarithm.

natural-log.def: A logarithm with base e (about 2.718), written ln. ln x is about 2.303 times log x.

antilog.def: The inverse of a logarithm: 10ˣ undoes log x and eˣ undoes ln x.
